policy: High and critical production advisories must be fixed, or explicitly accepted here for at most 60 days. Expired entries fail CI.

advisories.justification: Deepmerge stack exhaustion in the Prisma v6 CLI config loader. The loader runs only during generate/migrate/build against a trusted repository config; it is absent from the runtime server bundle. The fixed release is Prisma 7, which requires a breaking config/client migration and is scheduled separately.

Effect ReDoS in the Prisma v6 CLI config loader's template-literal validation. No untrusted runtime input reaches it; it is build-tool only. The fixed release is Prisma 7, deferred behind the v7 migration.
